title: 恐龙的名字是怎么来的
subtitle: 名字里藏着它长什么样
character: wearing a navy blue striped t-shirt, grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, fine pen lines with light watercolour washes laid over them, ink blue, warm sand and terracotta

pages.zh:
恐龙的名字
一个比一个长。
三角龙、霸王龙、
迅猛龙……
为什么都这么叫？
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy standing in front of a large dinosaur skull in a museum, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, puzzled.

pages.zh:
名字大多是拼出来的。
前面一半说它的样子，
后面那个「龙」，
原本的意思
是蜥蜴。

这只脸上有三只角，
两只在眼睛上方，
一只在鼻子上，
后面还撑着
一圈大骨头领子。
pages.scene: One triceratops standing in profile on a cream background, three horns on its face and a broad bony frill behind its head, its head turned so the face is clearly seen. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的名字拆开来：
三，角，脸。
连起来就是
「长着三只角的脸」。
名字就是一句描述。

这只头特别大，
牙像香蕉那么粗，
前面两只小手
短得够不着嘴。
谁见了都得让路。
pages.scene: One tyrannosaurus standing in profile on a cream background, its huge head open in a roar, its two short arms held close to its chest, a flat illustration filling the whole picture, not a photograph of an open book. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的名字拆开来：
暴君，蜥蜴，王。
合起来是
「暴君蜥蜴之王」。
听着就不好惹。

这只个头不大，
身上长着羽毛，
腿细，跑得飞快，
专挑别人不留神的时候
扑上去。
pages.scene: One feathered velociraptor running fast in profile on a cream background, its long stiff tail held straight out behind it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它的名字拆开来：
快，加上贼。
「跑得快的贼」——
给它起名的人
一定见过它的本事。

这只守着一窝蛋。
蛋孵出来以后，
它还接着喂。
所以人给它起名叫
「好妈妈蜥蜴」。
pages.scene: One maiasaura crouching over a round nest of eggs on a cream background, lowering its head towards them. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
还有些名字里
藏着地名。
禄丰龙在云南禄丰，
青岛龙在青岛——
在哪儿挖出来的。

也有些名字里
藏着人名，
记着是谁
第一个把它
从石头里挖出来。

原来每个名字
都是一句短短的话。
它长什么样，
有什么本事，
名字里全写着呢。
pages.scene: A head-and-shoulders portrait of the little boy standing beside a triceratops skull in a museum, only his head and shoulders inside the picture and everything below his chest outside the frame, his face turned straight towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, smiling as if he has just understood something.
